$comment: Veydan Pass: the modules of the product and the product itself. This file is written for the published snapshot ("snapshot" names its product): scripts/boundaries.sh checks what is here, ui/vite-veydan-modules.js builds the UI from the modules, scripts/product.sh gives the wrappers of the Tauri CLI the crate, the identifiers and the ports. A dev server does not notice an edit: restart it.
